model_annotation: The chart illustrates the negative log probability of various medical specialty terms for two models: Mistralv0.2-Base and Fine-tuned. The x-axis lists six per-specialty terms (Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, Pediatrics), while the y-axis represents the negative log probability, ranging from -27 to -22 with a linear scale and tick labels at every integer. The chart features grouped bars, with each group representing a per-specialty term and containing two bars: one for Mistralv0.2-Base (blue) and one for Fine-tuned (shades of orange to brown, corresponding to the respective specialty term). Each bar is approximately the same height within its group, with the Fine-tuned bars having varying shades corresponding to their respective specialty terms. The Fine-tuned bars have values ranging from approximately -26.5 to -22.5, with the lowest value for "Cardio" and the highest for "Pediatrics". The bars are not sorted in any particular order, and no bars are visually emphasized. The chart effectively compares the negative log probability of the two models across different medical specialty terms.
